shellCommands.command: git status --short && git log --oneline | head -5 && ls -la && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -200
cat package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts index.html .gitignore src/*.tsx src/*.ts && echo ---- && cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -80

ls node_modules | head -100; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; ls node_modules | grep -iE 'marked|markdown|dompurify|remark|micromark|sanitize' ; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; node -v; npm -v

ls node_modules/@uiw node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build 2>/dev/null | head -50; cat node_modules/@uiw/*/package.json | grep -E '"(name|version)"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | head -100

timeout 30 npm view marked version 2>&1 | tail -2; timeout 30 npm view dompurify version 2>&1 | tail -2; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/tabs node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/lab 2>/dev/null

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat controls/TextArea/TextArea.d.ts 2>/dev/null || ls controls/TextArea; echo ----; cat controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; echo ----; cat index.d.ts | head -80

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && timeout 180 npm install marked dompurify 2>&1 | grep -v 'Unknown env config' | tail -5; grep -E '"(marked|dompurify)"' package.json; ls node_modules/marked/package.json node_modules/dompurify/package.json && grep -E '"(types|typings)"' node_modules/marked/package.json node_modules/dompurify/package.json

grep -nE 'parse\b.*\(' node_modules/marked/lib/marked.d.ts | head -10; grep -n 'breaks\|gfm' node_modules/marked/lib/marked.d.ts | head; grep -rhoE '\-\-g-color-text-(primary|secondary|info)|\-\-g-color-line-generic|\-\-g-color-base-generic|\-\-g-color-base-generic-medium|\-\-g-spacing-[0-9]|\-\-g-border-radius-m' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/styles/ 2>/dev/null | sort | uniq -c | head -20; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles 2>/dev/null

grep -oE '\-\-g-color-(text|base|line)[a-z-]*' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | sort -u | head -40; grep -oE '\-\-g-(spacing|border-radius)[a-z0-9-]*' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | sort -u | head; grep -n 'parse' node_modules/marked/lib/marked.d.ts | sed -n '1,40p' | grep -E 'declare const|parse:|parse\(' | head -5; grep -nE 'export declare const marked|declare function parse' node_modules/marked/lib/marked.d.ts | head

grep -rlo 'g-color-text-primary' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles | head -3; grep -rhoE '\-\-g-color-(text|line)-[a-z-]+' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles | sort -u | head -20; grep -rhoE '\-\-g-(font|text)[a-z0-9-]*' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles | sort -u | head; grep -n 'export declare const marked\|export declare function marked\|declare const marked' node_modules/marked/lib/marked.d.ts | head -3

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && sed -n 1,40p Text/Text.d.ts; echo ----; grep -n 'type\b\|view\|size' Button/Button.d.ts | head -20; echo ----; grep -n 'id\b' controls/TextArea/TextArea.js | head -5
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -40

which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome google-chrome-stable firefox 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules | grep -iE 'playwright|puppeteer|jsdom|happy-dom'; timeout 60 npm view playwright version 2>/dev/null | tail -1

mkdir -p /tmp/pwcheck && cd /tmp/pwcheck && timeout 300 npm init -y >/dev/null 2>&1; timeout 300 npm install playwright@1.65.0 2>&1 | tail -2; timeout 400 npx playwright install --with-deps chromium 2>&1 | tail -4
cd /tmp/pwcheck && timeout 400 npx playwright install chromium 2>&1 | tail -4; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null
(npx vite --port 5173 --strictPort > /tmp/vite.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; cat /tmp/vite.log | tail -5; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:5173/
(npx vite --port 5199 --strictPort > /tmp/vite2.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; tail -3 /tmp/vite2.log; curl -s http://localhost:5199/src/App.tsx | head -3

pkill -f "vite --port 5199" ; cd /tmp/pwcheck && timeout 300 npm install jsdom@25 2>&1 | tail -1 && cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npx esbuild src/markdown.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=/tmp/pwcheck/markdown.mjs --external:jsdom 2>&1 | tail -2
for p in $(ps -eo pid,args | grep '[v]ite --port 5199' | awk '{print $1}'); do kill $p; done; rm -rf dist; git status --short; git diff --stat; grep -A4 '"dependencies"' package.json

for d in /proc/[0-9]*; do if tr '\0' ' ' < $d/cmdline 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'vite --port 5199'; then kill ${d#/proc/} && echo killed ${d#/proc/}; fi; done; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:5199/ || true
curl -s -m 3 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:5199/ ; echo "exit=$?"
